name: refdata-hub
description: A semi-automated reference data and standardization service for global projects. This service handles common reference dimensions (marital status, education, nationality, etc.) by semantically matching new raw values, routing them to reviewers for approval, and adding them to a central mapping

paragraphs: Automate, harmonize, and standardize reference data dimensions across global enterprise systems with AI-assisted semantic matching and intuitive human-in-the-loop curation workflows.
4. Match Insights & Curation Workflow Multi-Tiled Interactive Demo: Harmonizing unstandardized reference data across 4 core enterprise platform use cases.
RefData Hub is an open-source Reference Data Management (RDM) and Data Harmonization platform designed to solve reference data fragmentation across modern enterprise architectures.
features: Ingesting & Profiling raw source data from upstream databases.
Semantically Matching disparate raw values to canonical dimensions using AI embedding vectors or LLM-powered re-ranking.
Empowering Reviewers with a modern human-in-the-loop dashboard to inspect, approve, or refine suggestions.
Publishing Canonical Mappings to downstream data warehouses, business intelligence tools, and microservices.

🧠 AI-Assisted Semantic Matching: Harmonize messy reference data automatically using local sentence-transformer embeddings (fastembed), or configurable LLM providers (OpenAI API or local offline Ollama models) —…
